mechanic: Zone-header type: on Next, drops its held stack to the paired lower column, then draws a new card.

name: Input Adder (upper)
mechanic: Adds 1 Entrance input column per copy in the rule deck.

name: Inverted-blessing naming
mechanic: Debuff-granting cards carry well-wishing names, and vice versa.

name: Jack-of-all-trades
mechanic: Counts as every class at once, but at half effect (masters none).

name: Jaded city (Richiardi)
mechanic: Only shock (Danger/negative) acts impress here; a horror-show variant scoring rule applies.

name: Jaded fear-show town
mechanic: Debuff-inflicting cards are the headliners in fear shows.

name: John Robinson (elite)
mechanic: Shortened show: 2 submits instead of 3.

name: Judged-category scoring
mechanic: Some shows grade formation, suit variety, and stamps as separate scored categories instead of one total.

name: Judged festival (City Dionysia)
mechanic: Scores in separate categories (best formation/suit spread/single meld) instead of one total.

name: Juggler leader (Rastelli)
mechanic: Balls-suit cards can be kept aloft (re-scored) as long as one scores each submit.

name: Jump/duck reactions
mechanic: Feat cards dynamically jump up through hoops and duck under knives as projectiles pass.

name: Karuta duel
mechanic: A speed-pick minigame where the first click rewards.

name: Kneeling Devil
mechanic: A negative-effect card that, if kept a full tour, converts into a positive card at the final city.

name: Knife suit
mechanic: Mirrors Hoop but launches from the opposite row side and scores plain (prop) cards instead of talents.

name: Knives/Hoops horizontal projectiles
mechanic: Scored knife and hoop cards fly horizontally across their scored row; balls and fire drop down columns.

name: Kuroko
mechanic: This card is 'unseen': doesn't block Spotlight, can't be targeted by bosses.

name: Label / Evident
mechanic: Announces its rule-deck effect on the board even while the rule deck stays hidden.

name: Label/Evident card
mechanic: A card announces its rule-deck effect on the board while the rule deck itself stays hidden ('Baba Is You' visibility trick).

name: Lazzi trigger-macros
mechanic: Equippable trigger-macros: small scripted combos a card can rehearse.

name: Leader (type entry)
mechanic: Type that starts a card on the board or in the Entrance and boosts its group.

name: Leader chassis
mechanic: Leader cards start already on the board (or in the Entrance) and do not leave play on submit; different starting decks ship different leaders.

name: Leader elemental fears
mechanic: Optional debuff: some leaders fear fire/knives and cannot be placed on fire/knife cards.

name: Leader group boost
mechanic: Cards belong to groups/classes, and leader cards boost their group.

name: Leader lineage succession
mechanic: Retiring a maxed leader unlocks its heir with a carried-over power.

name: Liberty Horses
mechanic: On Next, all Animal-tagged cards in the Entrance rearrange themselves into ascending order.

name: Light
mechanic: Rises to the top of the deck (counterpart to Heavy, never built).

name: Literal spotlight beam
mechanic: Triggering cards get a literal spotlight beam instead of a generic glow; the whole screen may dim during submit.

name: Lithograph
mechanic: While in the Entrance (not the Ring), broadcasts its skill globally.

name: Live undo during resolution
mechanic: Pressing Undo during a resolving act cancels it: the resolution fast-forwards and the pre-act board state restores, with no act consumed.

name: Lore scraps unlock
mechanic: Wins/actions unlock lore scraps.

name: Mabel's Tigers
mechanic: Consumes the card it's dropped on (like Gluttony) but only prop cards; +rank per meal.

name: Magic deck
mechanic: Each suit is an element; submitting elemental combinations casts spells.

name: Magician class
mechanic: Class mechanical focus: card creation and deletion.

name: Magician leader (Tenkatsu)
mechanic: Produces token cards.

name: Mana cards
mechanic: Any card can serve as a resource instead of an abstract mana bar.

name: Mancala targeting
mechanic: Ball/Fire projectiles are ballistic: a mancala walk down the column picks a fixed count of talent targets at spawn; Fire's eligibility skips talents and other Fire props.

name: Map alternative topologies
mechanic: Alternatives considered: no final city (circle the map), must return to start, or visited points become revisitable after enough time passes.

name: Map click seeds next drop
mechanic: Clicking a map card made it the first card dropped in the next match.

name: MapNodeRoles
mechanic: Deterministically assigns show/booster/anchor roles to map nodes from the run seed.

name: Marked stamp
mechanic: The player always knows where this card currently sits in the deck.

name: Marketed monster
mechanic: Terrifies (debuffs) adjacent cards while secretly being a gentle Humbug.

name: Masked satire (Talchum)
mechanic: Heat (infamy) is earned safely because a mask absorbs the town's anger.

name: Maximum Effort / Exhaust
mechanic: Double (or flat bonus) points from this card on score; only refreshes if the card is NOT played/scored the following show.

name: Meal call (cookhouse flag)
mechanic: A mid-tour rest tick heals one debuff per card, once per region.

name: Mid-show instant tips
mechanic: Overscoring a single meld pays out instantly instead of at show end.

name: Milk Can
mechanic: Cue: place a card inside; it leaves play; retrieve it any later turn.

name: Minesweeper board
mechanic: Full deck laid face-down; only cards adjacent to a revealed card can be clicked; clicking triggers a battle for that card and reveals its neighbors; win by uncovering all cards.

name: Mini-game score-free events
mechanic: Some encounters replace score-to-win with alternate win-con puzzles, e.g. 'trigger 5 times to win.'

name: Misdirection theft
mechanic: When the biggest meld of a submit scores, a pickpocket event may trigger, or a card steals from the town for bonus gold.

name: Misrule show
mechanic: For one show, all ranks are reversed (2 counts high, King counts low); winning it pays huge tips.

name: Mobile pageant zone
mechanic: A zone/column relocates each turn.

name: Mock the Booking
mechanic: Reduce the declared Booking goal once per tour.

name: Modifier-driven grab/place legality
mechanic: Stacking legality is decided by a resolver pass: all cards' allow/deny effects are gathered into a whitelist and blacklist, with the blacklist winning over the whitelist.

name: Money on Trigger
mechanic: Gain money whenever the card triggers.

name: Moonstruck (Pierrot)
mechanic: Buffs on alternating ('night') shows, pines (does nothing/less) otherwise.

name: Mountebank tonics
mechanic: Cheap buffs with a chance of doing nothing (being water).

name: Movement-resistant cards
mechanic: Cards that resist being moved once placed.

name: Mud Show
mechanic: Picking up any stack costs 1 discard.

name: Mystery Box
mechanic: On game start, becomes a random skill.

name: Named court card identities
mechanic: Face cards have hidden historical identities discoverable through play; uncovering all 12 grants a meta reward.

name: Negative weather effects
mechanic: Weather events impose negative effects, framed as 'the show must go on.'

name: New scoring methods
mechanic: Skill taxonomy category: cards that create new ways to score.

name: No-conditions cue
mechanic: This card's cue works with zero requirements, from anywhere.

name: Nominal suit subclasses
mechanic: Each suit is a nominal PipSuit subclass (Hoop/Knife/Ball/Fire/Firework) with no ordinal value, constructed explicitly rather than compared by index.

name: Null cards
mechanic: Null cards take up space on the board and are highlighted when selected so hovering over null space reads clearly.

name: Odd couple buff
mechanic: The thinnest (lowest rank) and heaviest (highest rank) card in a row buff each other.

name: OG Grabber
mechanic: Provides the default grab legality: ascending/descending runs, no same-suit stacking.

name: OG Placer
mechanic: Provides the default placement legality rule.

name: One-upmanship duel (scissors dance)
mechanic: Alternate melds with a rival, each must out-score the last; first to fall short loses everything wagered.

name: Only first poker hand scores
mechanic: Only the first (best) scored poker hand on a row actually scores; later poker hands on the same line are ignored.

name: Only legal stacks liftable
mechanic: Only legal stacks can be picked up at all, making moving stacks harder as the run progresses.

name: Out-of-game ARG secret
mechanic: A mystery solvable only through outside research.

name: Outcast Troupe deck
mechanic: Cheaper everywhere but banned from rich towns; built from exactly six classes (one per Namsadang art).

name: Outlawed cards
mechanic: Cards banned in pious towns (cannot score there) but score double in others; persecution can spawn an underground-shows event chain.

name: Overscore tax retired
mechanic: The overscore tax was retired: wins now bank the full score as fame with no separate penalty.

name: Overscoring ramps requirements
mechanic: Overscoring ramps up future score requirements, so the player balances declaring a big score (fame wagering) against the risk of missing it.

name: Paired giants
mechanic: Each of a pair gets +mult while both are on the board.

name: Panem et circenses free show
mechanic: Give a free show: zero gold earned, big fame gain, town loyalty increased.

name: Panorama consumable
mechanic: Reveals the whole map's silhouette.

name: Paper
mechanic: Default/basic material with no special effect.

name: Peanut Pitch
mechanic: Cue (3 charges): add points to any one card, thrown from anywhere.

name: Peek-over presentation
mechanic: Cards with skills idly move and peek over the card blocking them; blocked active cards shift the row below to show at least their upper art half.

name: Pepper's Ghost
mechanic: An intangible duplicate of one card appears in the opposite zone; scores as if real but can't be touched or attacked.

name: Per-act score multiplier
mechanic: Each act (or only the final act) could carry an increasing score multiplier.

name: Per-card personal bests
mechanic: Personal bests are recorded on the card itself; beating one's own record fires a fame event.

name: Per-level rule deck
mechanic: Rejected: replacing the rule deck with a per-level deck, since score goals live outside the rule deck and building UI from it is scope creep.

name: Per-meld suit firing
mechanic: A scored card's suit effect fires once per meld membership (once for its row, once for its column); talented (skill-bearing) cards suppress their own suit effect.

name: Per-scenario rule decks
mechanic: Game rules determine what Next and Submit do; different scenarios swap in different rule decks, and edits during a run are permanent for that run.

name: Performance Rings (origin)
mechanic: Every 5 rows scored increases points 'by layer' / turns the row red — the seed idea that became Performance Rings.

name: Performance Rings
mechanic: Score zones by board depth: the First Ring (rows 1-5) scores at 1x, rows 6-10 at 2x, rows 11-15 at 3x, and so on, enabling effects keyed to reaching outer rings.

name: Performance Rings as depth multiplier
mechanic: Performance Rings act as multipliers on the column combo specifically, rewarding tall play.

name: Permanent-toggle effect archetype
mechanic: An effect archetype that, once activated, stays active for the rest of the game and can never be toggled off again.

name: Persistent spin-buff (Sangmo)
mechanic: A spin-buff persists as long as the combo continues.

name: Pip comparator resolver
mechanic: A pip resolver/comparator class governs all rank/suit comparisons; card mods are asked first (on_compare_ranks/suits) with numeric fallback.

name: Pip-registered scoring methods
mechanic: Each pip class can register its own static scoring methods as defaults for that pip; pip effects are permanently active, unlike skills.

name: Player-editable rule deck
mechanic: Metagame idea: the player can modify the ruleset deck during a run by adding or removing default cards.

name: Poker Crown (unnamed)
mechanic: When scored, this card and the 4 cards above it are scored together as a poker hand.

name: Poker Evaluator
mechanic: Performs best-poker-hand evaluation per line.

name: Power-sort rarity
mechanic: Rarity is determined by how far a base effect has been power-climbed into a stronger version of the same idea (e.g. Hippo to Sin of Gluttony).

name: Pre-show challenge dance
mechanic: Sacrifice a turn to open with an intimidation display that lowers the fame goal.

name: Presentation
mechanic: Moving cards into ascending order gives multiplier points.

name: Press Bribery / Memory Wipe
mechanic: Extra life: on failing a city, keep going as if the player had won; possibly a straight win if held to the end.

name: Prestige meta-shop
mechanic: Wins grant prestige currency spent in the Carnival meta-shop on map odds, starting resources, true vision, guaranteed cards/packs, a full unlock reset, or the custom deck editor; spending raises per-show score requirements.

name: Producer / Manager class
mechanic: Class mechanical focus: token cards — gold/money cards and basic cards.

name: Projectile hit/miss bonuses
mechanic: Gain mult for every hoop passing through an animal or acrobat, every knife missing a stuntsman, every ball hitting a juggler or animal; fire buffs cards it passes through.

name: Prop-vs-feat suit targeting
mechanic: Knives reward hitting non-feat (prop) cards, hoops reward hitting feat cards; balls buff feat cards, fire buffs non-feat cards, with balls/fire spreading buffs evenly across the column.

name: Psycho
mechanic: An Automaton card plays a card from the deck by itself every Next.

name: Punch
mechanic: Beats adjacent cards for points.

name: Punk / Minimal unlockable decks
mechanic: A Punk deck (rule-breaking commons, no Producer class) and a Minimal deck (pips only) as unlockable philosophies.

name: Quests (TFT-style)
mechanic: Extremely random conditions cause permanent effects, emphasizing unlocking; effects upgrade themselves into better versions when conditions are met.

name: Quick-change (Hikinuki)
mechanic: On scoring, swap this card's stamp with any stamp in reserve.

name: Railroad Jump (route hazard)
mechanic: Traveling a long map edge costs a card from the deck (left behind on the platform).

name: Random standard suit roster
mechanic: The standard random suit roster is [Hoop, Knife, Ball, Fire]; Firework is excluded from random rolls and instead rises up its column, banking column score at the top.

name: Rare (chain)
mechanic: Doubles the chance of Epic cards appearing.

name: Rarity visual tiers
mechanic: Different rarities get different borders, shines, and possibly holographic effects.

name: Removing unwanted cards
mechanic: Skill taxonomy category: cards that remove unwanted cards.

name: Repositioning
mechanic: Skill taxonomy category: cards that reposition cards on the board.

name: Reroll Blessing effect archetype
mechanic: +1 reroll per game; repeated actions will not repeat the same results for the rest of the game.

name: Residency mode
mechanic: An alternate endless mode where the player stays in one evolving city instead of circling the map.

name: Resort towns
mechanic: Lower goals, better shops, no bosses.

name: Revealing (Eye)
mechanic: Card triggers even when hidden/covered.

name: Ringmaster
mechanic: No suit/rank; starts in the Entrance; always grabbable; can be placed anywhere uncovered; survives submission.

name: Ringmaster leader spec
mechanic: No suit or rank; type starts it in the Entrance; stamp lets it always be picked up and placed anywhere uncovered; skill keeps it on board after submission.

name: Roman numeral rank
mechanic: Cosmetic rank skin; melds identically to a normal rank.

name: Rookie growth cards
mechanic: Rookie commons with growth conditions that upgrade them over time.

name: Rosin
mechanic: Cards placed on it cannot be picked up again, but score +1 per ring depth when scored.

name: Rotation re-trigger naming / fail-to-unlock
mechanic: Re-trigger counts are named as rotations; a card must publicly fail N times before unlocking its true form.

name: Route-as-song bonus
mechanic: Repeating a traveled route pattern 'in the right order' grants a strengthening bonus.

name: Route-length achievements
mechanic: Achievements for total walked/traveled map distance.

name: Row-then-column evaluation order
mechanic: Evaluation proceeds top-down: poker hands are scored first, with each column's run calculated simultaneously as that row resolves; refined to score all rows first, then all lanes simultaneously at that row.

name: Row x column aggregation
mechanic: All vertical (column) scores are multiplied together with all horizontal (row) scores at the end of a submit.

name: Rule cards as a type
mechanic: Rule cards are not special: they are a card type whose skill is 'always global spotlight'; other types can define 'return to deck X when Y.'

name: Rule cards get random pips
mechanic: Rule cards are given a random suit and rank in case a player ever extracts one into normal play.

name: Rules-in-hand deck
mechanic: Rule deck is empty; all rules are shuffled into the main deck.

name: Rules-in-hand deck variant
mechanic: A deck variant where the rule deck is empty and all rules are shuffled into and drawn from the main deck.

name: Run the monte (thrower)
mechanic: Play the monte-thrower role yourself for gold, risking town reputation.

name: Séance Night
mechanic: Pick the Gaff out of 3 face-down cards for a reward.

name: Sacred juggling (Daikagura)
mechanic: Balls-suit scoring removes one debuff per juggling meld.

name: Satirical Animal Trainer leader
mechanic: Satire angers towns (fame up, town relations down); pigs can mock the Booking.

name: Sawdust
mechanic: When discarded, leaves a marker on its board slot; the next card placed there gets +points.

name: Scan deck/discard for scoring
mechanic: Open idea: scoring could also scan the draw deck and discard pile, not just the board.

name: Score goal per-layer increment
mechanic: Score goal increments per match, currently x1.1 per layer.

name: Score slots
mechanic: Score slots on the right score whatever is placed on them and double as free spaces between deck clicks.

name: Scripted clown combos
mechanic: Clown combos are scripted sequences (lazzi) with an end-of-sequence bonus.

source: DESIGN_RECOMMENDATIONS.md §1 How I read your design
name: Searing Knife (adopt)
mechanic: Column hazard card enables town/boss content around knife scoring.

name: Searing Knife (summary)
mechanic: On score, burns its column, locking it for 2 turns.

name: Seasonal crown
mechanic: A per-season champion title (Calypso Monarch); extempo joins the verse-duel family.

name: Second Act
mechanic: Deck-position type: shows up alone after half the deck has been drawn.

name: Secret meld unlocks new rules
mechanic: Cards can carry secret on-add-to-deck effects that add entirely new rules once discovered.

name: Self-granted title
mechanic: A card names itself Rare, counting as one rarity higher for effect purposes only (not for drop pools).

name: Seven Pyramid
mechanic: A 7-card stack formation meld with a huge payout.

name: Shared charge system
mechanic: All charge-based effects share one charge system so charges can be gained/lost from any source; unused charges auto-spend on Next.

name: Shop-as-board-buttons
mechanic: Shops are built out of the game board itself; every button (e.g. reroll) is a tappable card.

name: Show-all-active toggle
mechanic: A half-open-eye QOL toggle pushes stacks apart so every spotlit card is fully visible; disabled while holding a stack.

name: Sin of Gluttony
mechanic: Upgraded Hippo: no value cap, can be fed from anywhere including decks, and permanently consumes fed cards.

source: DESIGN_RECOMMENDATIONS.md §1 How I read your design
name: Sliced Reality (reject)
mechanic: Changes column count; redundant with ZoneAdder rule cards.

name: Sliced Reality (summary)
mechanic: Splits a column into two, or merges two columns into one.

name: Slot-machine pack opening
mechanic: Pack opening shows all possible contents in the background, slot-machine styled, with results seed-fixed.

name: Small-tent starting deck (Carpas)
mechanic: A weak starting deck with an underdog-to-star meta arc.

name: Snake Oil
mechanic: A buff that sometimes does nothing (is secretly a Gaff); selling it yourself is an economy event with reputation risk.

name: Spangle
mechanic: +1 combo whenever this card is part of any meld.

name: Special Effects class
mechanic: Class mechanical focus: points/combo manipulation.

name: Special map squares
mechanic: Special squares carry fixed effects, e.g. all 7-value squares are shops; higher ranks are likelier toward the center (probability rings).

name: Special suits via packs only
mechanic: Fireworks and Electric are special suits that appear only via packs/effects, never in the base roster, like wild/stone enhancements.

name: Speedrun endless categories
mechanic: Endless-mode rulesets are shipped as speedrun categories (Any%, 100%, Glitchless) with named personal bests.

name: Spiderweb
mechanic: 1 point per card diagonal to this card, in a cross/X shape.

name: Spinning-plate buffs
mechanic: Stackable buffs that decay unless re-triggered.

name: Spirit Photo consumable
mechanic: Capture a 'ghost copy' of any card for one show.

name: Sponsorship
mechanic: A patron funds the tour (gold every show) but stamps ads on cards, imposing a fame tax.

name: Spotlight rebrand
mechanic: Active state is rebranded Spotlight/Focus: a card is 'in the spotlight' when unblocked/topmost; card text gets an icon marking which effects need spotlight and which don't.

name: Stamp as diegetic hat/equipment
mechanic: Stamps could be reflavored as an equippable hat or other equipment (shoes, costume), tying into a Costume Designer class.

name: StampGlobal
mechanic: Card's modifiers are active from anywhere, including inside decks.

name: StampRevealing
mechanic: Card's modifiers remain active even while covered (not topmost).

name: Status array
mechanic: CardData carries a status dictionary (effect name -> value) processed by rule cards per effect, as the general mechanism for debuffs.

name: Stone
mechanic: Stubbed material type with no defined effect yet.

name: Storyteller
mechanic: Preserves some points into the next game.

name: Storyteller cross-game persistence
mechanic: Scoring done outside the main game carries into the next game, e.g. via the Storyteller card preserving points between games.

name: Storyteller's Dance
mechanic: Re-triggers the last effect that fired on an adjacent card.

name: Straw House
mechanic: When tips exceed X, the next node's offers get +1 rarity.

name: Style flourish (Mie)
mechanic: A scored meld holds on screen a beat longer for +tips.

name: Suit-punishing hazard towns
mechanic: Towns punish specific suit scoring (Knifetown scores knives at 0, similarly Firetown/Juggletown/Hooptown); performing at a volcano adds lava hazards.

name: Sunshine (Popov)
mechanic: A clown that only buffs, never gags; heals debuffs on the cards below it.

name: Survivor deck
mechanic: Suits represent survival resources: food, water, sword, etc.

name: Sword Swallower
mechanic: A column that forms one perfect descending run from deck-to-floor triggers a secret meld.

name: Sword swallowing (fakir)
mechanic: Swallow a Knife-suit card into this card; produce it later at increased rank.

name: Sword swallowing (Edith Clifford)
mechanic: Permanently swallows a Knife card, adding its rank to this card's forever.

name: Symmetrical Show (rule)
mechanic: Poker hands are also evaluated vertically, not just horizontally.

name: Talent pack mulligan
mechanic: Booster packs are opened by mulliganing the results arena-style; contents are previewable, mulligan count is upgradable, and unseen effects show a question mark.

name: Tango pair
mechanic: Two cards locked in embrace, always adjacent, alternating each turn which one's skill fires.

name: Tappable Clown (summary)
mechanic: 3 taps: randomizes adjacent cards.

name: Ten-in-One pack
mechanic: A pack type containing 10 common cards.

name: Ten-suit challenge deck
mechanic: A ten-suit unlockable challenge deck (Ganjifa-inspired).

name: The 42-Foot Ring
mechanic: A secret meld triggers when a row's and column's scores total exactly 42.

name: The Academy
mechanic: A meta building trains (permanently upgrades) one common card per season into its rare version.

source: DESIGN_RECOMMENDATIONS.md §1 How I read your design
name: The Acrobat (adopt)
mechanic: Card can be grabbed even while covered by another card.

name: The Acrobat (summary)
mechanic: Grabbable even when covered.

name: The Advance Man
mechanic: Map consumable/skill that reveals fog-of-war nodes ahead of the player.

name: The All-Nighter
mechanic: A triple-length show: 3x submits, 3x goal, 3x reward.

name: The Ambitious Card
mechanic: Always rises to the top of the deck after shuffles; a related secret rewards beating a 'Houdini' boss with it.

source: DESIGN_RECOMMENDATIONS.md §1 How I read your design
name: The Anarchist (reject as player card)
mechanic: Silences/disables the rule deck while in play; recommended as a boss effect rather than a player card.

name: The Anarchist (summary)
mechanic: Disables all other Rule cards while in the Ring.

name: The Arcade
mechanic: A minigame node reusing solitaire-variant events for tickets.

name: The At Liberty pool
mechanic: Between towns, hire discounted cards other 'shows' have dropped.

name: The audience warns you
mechanic: The crowd (UI) shouts a warning one step before a hazard hits a card; villains earn boos (heat).

name: The Avatar
mechanic: A card wears another card's face/identity; unmasking rules apply.

name: The Backlift
mechanic: Scores +N per card currently stacked on top of this card.

name: The Backward-Backward
mechanic: Reverses a run's direction mid-meld: a descending run counts as ascending for one column.

name: The Bahurupiya
mechanic: Arrives each show as a random different class.

name: The Balance boss
mechanic: Cannot be defeated, only balanced: end the show with row points and column points within X% of each other.

name: The Barrel
mechanic: A one-time colossal fame gain with zero gold reward.

name: The Basket
mechanic: 'Destroys' a card into the basket; it reappears in the Entrance next show, unharmed, granting +fame.

name: The Bauta
mechanic: While worn, the card's rarity and identity are hidden from effects, inspections, and towns.

name: The Belt
mechanic: Exactly one card in the world holds it, doubling that card; belt-challenge bosses can take it away.

name: The Birdman Race
mechanic: A first-to-claim seasonal contest; the winning card holds a tour-long title.

name: The Blank
mechanic: No rank and no suit; stacks legally on anything and anything can stack on it; scores 0 points.

name: The Blind Spot
mechanic: While the town inspector watches one zone, banned (Outlawed) cards can act in the other zone.

name: The Blockhead
mechanic: Absorbs one Knife projectile per show as points instead of damage.

name: The Board (Ouija)
mechanic: Ask the deck one yes/no question per show.

source: DESIGN_RECOMMENDATIONS.md §2.2 Alt win cons: The Booking
name: The Booking
mechanic: A contract card sits in the rule deck for the show; player declares a booking (e.g. score X with no knife melds, win in 2 submits, trigger 12 unique feats) and the show is won by fulfilling it rather than by max score.

name: The Boot Code
mechanic: Adjacent cards pass a buff down a row via untriggered 'rhythm,' untraceable by boss effects that punish triggers.

name: The Box Theater
mechanic: Cueing it runs a one-card mini-submit inside itself.

name: The Brass Ring
mechanic: A bonus token rotates around the board's columns each turn; scoring the column while the ring sits on it grants a grab bonus.

name: The Butoh Walker
mechanic: Moves one slot every other turn, permanently transforming (buffing) every slot it passes through.

name: The Butterfly Trick
mechanic: Creates fluttering paper-token cards (rank 1, any suit) that drift down one column per turn.

name: The Called Shot
mechanic: Destroys the top card of any stack, leaving the rest of the stack intact.

name: The Calm Voice
mechanic: Negates one disaster event by converting it into a show, gaining fame from the crisis.

name: The Cannon King (Zacchini)
mechanic: Fireworks-suit cards may score from the Entrance.

name: The Capoeirista
mechanic: Registered as a Dancer but functions as a fighter; performs even in towns that ban combat acts.

name: The Card Index
mechanic: Cue: search the deck for any card and put it in the Entrance.

name: The Castell
mechanic: Build a tower and crown it with the smallest card for a massive bonus, with collapse risk scaling per level; a four-word motto maps to four buff types.

name: The Chamber (Waxworks)
mechanic: A museum node that buys 'likenesses' of the player's destroyed cards for gold.

name: The Charm
mechanic: Card text describes one trigger (music) while the real trigger is something else (movement).

name: The Chest
mechanic: The card's weight (Heavy/Light) flips depending on whether the player or an effect is moving it.

name: The Chorus (Kecak)
mechanic: +mult per rank-1 card on the board whenever any meld scores.

name: The Claimed Feat
mechanic: Scores fame for a stunt that never happened; if exposed later, lose double.

name: The clean dodge (Recortadores)
mechanic: When a hazard targets this card's column, it vaults the hazard, which passes through and scores points instead.

name: The Cliffhanger
mechanic: Ending a show mid-trick plummets the next town's fame requirement, but the trick must be 'resolved' there.

name: The Clock Hang
mechanic: Placed half-off the board's last column for double spotlight and double score, but risks a random gust that drops it.

name: The Collective deck
mechanic: A leaderless deck where every card shares the ensemble's average power; +mult if the deck contains no rares.

name: The Committee
mechanic: Submit a Gaff for 'testing': huge reward if it survives scrutiny, destroyed if not.

name: The Contortionist
mechanic: Folds to share a single board slot with another card.

name: The Cooler
mechanic: Replace the remaining draw deck with a perfectly pre-ordered copy, once per run.

name: The Costumier
mechanic: Cards may hold 2 stamps instead of 1.

name: The Courier
mechanic: A card straddles two columns at once, scoring in both.

name: The Crowd Surf
mechanic: Passes a card across the tops of all columns hand-to-hand, gaining +1 per column crossed, but is discarded if any column is empty.

name: The Crowd Takes Over
mechanic: For one turn, a seeded-random 'audience' makes the player's moves.

name: The Cutting Contest
mechanic: Alternating melds where each must beat the previous score.

name: The Demolition Show
mechanic: Discarding scores points per card destroyed instead of playing normally.

name: The Designated Loser
mechanic: A boss the player always beats, with a hidden 1-in-1000 chance it wins instead.

name: The Diplomatic Show
mechanic: Defuse a hostile town with one perfect performance instead of meeting its score requirement.

name: The Dirty Opening
mechanic: Show starts with all cards debuffed ('muddy'); every card that scores anyway earns double.

name: The Disaster March
mechanic: A hidden audio cue plays one turn before a surprise boss effect, rewarding players who learn the tell.

name: The Discoverie
mechanic: A book card that reveals every Gaff/fake in play; banned in some towns.

name: The Diva
mechanic: Strongest card in her class, but her skill is disabled unless placed first each show.

name: The Double
mechanic: Takes destruction meant for its assigned 'star' card.

name: The Drone Swarm
mechanic: Projects any formation bonus the player has previously scored, without needing the original cards.

name: The Dubplate
mechanic: A custom exclusive card forged for the player's save file only; clash events let it be 'played' against rival shows.

name: The Duck
mechanic: Pretends to consume cards (they secretly go to a hidden store, retrievable later) — a fake Gluttony.

name: The Eating Contest
mechanic: A sanctioned outing for Hippo/Gluttony/Tigers-family cards to consume the town's offering faster than a rival.

name: The Egg Bag
mechanic: A container card that always appears 'empty' when checked but produces a card when it matters.

name: The Egress (event)
mechanic: Following a mysterious sign skips the node entirely, with no reward and no risk.

name: The Elimination Save
mechanic: When two cards would be destroyed/discarded at once, they duel and the winner survives.

name: The Encore Exit
mechanic: Voluntarily discard this card mid-show; it is called back next turn at +rank.

name: The Endless Fan
mechanic: Draw +1 card every turn while spotlit.

name: The Equestrian (Astley)
mechanic: Melds scored in the First Ring (first 5x5) get +mult.

name: The Erdnase Cipher
mechanic: A card-author signature appears on random cards across many runs; collecting/scoring all of them unlocks an unexplained reward.

name: The Exile (daily challenge)
mechanic: An endless-mode vignette used as a hard, fixed daily-challenge layout.

name: The Exploration Show
mechanic: No score goal; only hidden bonuses to find in a pre-built board.

name: The Faire
mechanic: A reverse show where the town's audience are performers and the player's cards judge them, for easy fame.

name: The Fanchant
mechanic: Melds are 'answered' by the crowd via delayed echo scoring once town loyalty is high enough.

name: The Faro Bank
mechanic: A gambling node where the house cheats, and the player may cheat back.

name: The Fifteen
mechanic: Card also melds with any neighboring cards whose ranks sum to 15 (cribbage rule), as a rare pip ability rather than a default rule.

name: The Fire (venue loss)
mechanic: Lose a venue mid-tour; an insurance/rebuild choice defines the next act.

name: The Fire Marshal
mechanic: Flames-suit cards cannot score; Flames cards in the deck become Wax.

name: The First Juggler
mechanic: An ancient Balls-suit card grants an oldest-trick-in-the-book bonus for scoring the simplest possible meld.

name: The Flash Mob
mechanic: Deploys the entire Entrance to the board in one action, once per show.

name: The Flyting
mechanic: An insult-duel against a town champion; the winner takes fame from the loser.

name: The Foot Juggler
mechanic: Holds one card suspended in a sub-slot above itself, spinning, as a playable stored card.

name: The Forged Ace
mechanic: A counterfeit card of enormous value; if a town inspects it, the run's economy takes a penalty.

name: The Free Show
mechanic: A no-fee performance: heals the whole deck one debuff, gains no gold.

name: The friendly grapple (Glíma)
mechanic: A no-stakes duel node to test a card against a boss's stats without risk.

name: The Gaff
mechanic: Wild pip that displays a fixed rank/suit until scored, then reveals its true randomly-determined value.

name: The Gathering
mechanic: A festival node where every regional card pool is available at once, one purchase each.

name: The Ghost Show
mechanic: After real-world midnight, one secret card can only be found in the menu.

name: The Ghost Train
mechanic: A blind node whose contents can't be previewed, offering better average rewards.

name: The Giant
mechanic: Occupies a 2x2 board footprint, kept active by adjacent 'crew' cards.

name: The Gift Exchange
mechanic: Trade one of the player's cards for one of the town's, both sides choosing blind.

name: The Golden Buzzer
mechanic: Skips one town's requirement entirely, with confetti.

name: The Grand Vanish
mechanic: Hides an entire column (can't be seen, targeted, or scored) for a turn, then it returns with interest.

name: The Griot
mechanic: Preserves score/combo between shows, and re-triggers one effect from the previous show.

name: The Grip
mechanic: The bottom card of a stack holds everything above it legal, regardless of normal stacking rules.

name: The Guardian (Moko jumbie)
mechanic: From its column, reveals boss intentions one turn early.

name: The Guest Star
mechanic: A legendary card joins for exactly N shows then departs, unless a secret condition keeps it permanently.

name: The Half card
mechanic: A half-rank card that takes up only half a slot, so two halves fit one board slot.

name: The Hat
mechanic: After any show, an optional flourish converts leftover combo into gold instead of fame.

name: The Headliner (Ace)
mechanic: Face-card rename; counts as high or low rank in runs (real solitaire ace rule).

name: The Heel Turn
mechanic: Flips the leader to heel mode mid-tour: new powers, every town's reaction changes, no going back this run.

name: The High Dive
mechanic: Drop a card from the top of a column to the bottom for points that scale with fall height.

name: The Holdout
mechanic: Store one card outside the game; insert it into any stack at any moment (once); if a town 'searches' the player, it is lost.

name: The Hologram Tour
mechanic: Resurrects one destroyed card for one show as an intangible Pepper's Ghost duplicate.

name: The Hometown Hero
mechanic: Names the current town when scored, granting a small bonus in every town universally.

name: The Hook
mechanic: A boss/town removes the player's weakest card mid-show unless it scored last submit.

name: The Hunger Artist
mechanic: Gains +N for every consecutive show it stays in the deck unplayed; scores a huge burst when finally played, then resets.

name: The Illustrated card
mechanic: Can hold unlimited stamps but no other slot content.

name: The Imitator
mechanic: A Gaff copy of another card in the deck that scores more than the original while the original is absent.

name: The Impersonation
mechanic: Copy the skill of a card that was destroyed this run.

name: The Incubator
mechanic: Exhibited (covered) cards recover debuffs/ranks while 'on display.'

name: The Instrument
mechanic: A prop card keeps 'failing' (moving away) until finally played, then scores everything it dodged.

name: The interlude (Kyōgen)
mechanic: A small comic bonus round between boss shows that heals debuffs.

name: The International Final
mechanic: Neighboring map regions 'vote': suits favored by regions the player toured generously score extra.

name: The Invisible Wall
mechanic: Blocks one column with nothing: no card is there, but nothing can enter or leave for a turn.

name: The Joey (Jack)
mechanic: Face-card rename to a troupe role; unlocks 'Joey synergy' clown cards.

name: The Joey (Grimaldi, leader)
mechanic: Once per turn, free use of Slapstick (swap adjacent ranks).

name: The Junk Orchestra
mechanic: Prop cards score by 'rhythm' (a positional pattern).

name: The Kayfabe rule card
mechanic: While in play, all Gaffs/Humbugs count as real and score as what they pretend to be; removing it reverts everything.

name: The Kickline
mechanic: A full-row Dancer formation bonus when all 5 columns' top cards share a suit.

name: The Kite
mechanic: Launches a card above the board (out of play); it returns on a chosen later turn with a wind bonus.

name: The Lantern Roast
mechanic: The town satirizes the run's failures for laughs; accept for fame or take offense.

name: The Laughing Duel
mechanic: A pattern-matching minigame against a town where breaking rhythm (misclicking/failing a meld) loses.

name: The Lecture
mechanic: An 'educational' framing converts any card's flavor text into fame.

name: The Leotard
mechanic: Cue: move this card and everything stacked above it to any column, legal or not.

name: The Lion
mechanic: A card is secretly two cards, splitting when destroyed; placing it harvests a bonus from the card beneath it.

name: The Lion's Bride
mechanic: Scores for occupying the same column as a dangerous Animal card without being eaten.

name: The Little Umbrella
mechanic: A prop card that lets its holder perform Acrobat moves.

name: The Locked Room
mechanic: A node requiring specific card types as 'keys' to open its reward.

name: The Machine (fortune-teller)
mechanic: Pay a gold card to receive a guaranteed true fact about the next 3 nodes.

name: The Major Arcana
mechanic: 22 unique one-shot consumables, e.g. The Tower destroys a column, The Wheel rerolls a row's ranks, The Hanged Man flips a stack's order.

name: The Manager
mechanic: Cues an adjacent card's ability as its own action.

name: The Marathon
mechanic: A multi-show gauntlet where the board does not fully reset between shows.

name: The Marotte
mechanic: The card carries a mini-copy of itself; if destroyed, the copy survives at rank 1.

name: The Mask Wager
mechanic: Stakes a card's stamp/identity in a duel; unmasking is permanent across the save file.

name: The Masked Audience / One-on-One
mechanic: Fame sources are hidden around the board to be found; a One-on-One event performs for a single audience token for outsized intimate fame.

name: The Mighty Atom
mechanic: A rank-3 card that can legally hold any size stack above it.

name: The Minimal deck
mechanic: No stamps, no types; pure pips and stacking only.

name: The Mitt Camp
mechanic: Pay for a reading: a true random fact about the run's future, seeded so it's always honest.

name: The modern Committee
mechanic: Stake a Gaff against a huge prize; survive scrutiny for a fortune.

name: The Monkey (Sarumawashi)
mechanic: A token climbs one column per turn and cues whatever card it sits on.

name: The Murga
mechanic: Scores based on the run's history: +points per boss beaten, per card lost, per event survived.

name: The Museum of Humbugs
mechanic: Buy a cheap Gaff card that has a small chance of secretly being a Legendary.

name: The New Act
mechanic: An unheard-of attraction (a mechanic not yet unlocked) previews for one show.

name: The Ofrenda Show
mechanic: For one night, destroyed and discarded cards return from the discard pile to perform a single show, then rest again.

name: The Overrun
mechanic: The show goes free (zero gold), but grants enormous permanent fame and permanently changes the town.

name: The Ox
mechanic: Its destruction IS its act: the town celebrates (fame) when it's destroyed, and it revives next show.

name: The Palace / death trail naming
mechanic: The final city is named The Palace; circuits become route templates, with a 'death trail' as the hardest route.

name: The Patch
mechanic: Cancels one town penalty/hazard before it applies.

name: The Pickup (dzhigitovka)
mechanic: During the Next-phase drop animation, snatch one falling card and redirect its column.

name: The Pie Car
mechanic: Rest node: heal one debuff, or gamble at a rigged Three-Card Monte for a tiny chance of a big win.

name: The Pitch Lottery
mechanic: Bid gold cards for first pick of the next three nodes.

name: The Pole (Mallakhamb)
mechanic: Buffs everything in its column, more so the taller the column grows.

name: The Pose (Sandow)
mechanic: Scores by being displayed (spotlit doing nothing) rather than melded.

name: The Pose (Voguing)
mechanic: Holding a scored formation one extra beat grants bonus tips.

name: The Prepared Town
mechanic: Pre-inspects everything: all Gaffs and Humbugs are disabled here.

name: The Procession
mechanic: A moving meld walks one column per turn, collecting +1 from each column it crosses.

name: The Puppet (Bunraku)
mechanic: A powerful card that only functions with 2+ adjacent supporting cards.

name: The Puszta Five
mechanic: For one turn, one card straddles all columns, scoring in every column's meld.

source: DESIGN_REFERENCES.md §A8 Middle East, Central Asia, Mongolia
name: The Pyramid (Moroccan tumblers)
mechanic: A formation meld: 3 cards atop 2 atop 1 across adjacent columns.

name: The Radio Dummy
mechanic: A card whose stated gimmick is nullified by its board context, and which scores anyway.

name: The Rappings
mechanic: A 'haunted' node where answers come by knocks; debunking it does not un-haunt the town.

name: The Raree Box
mechanic: Peek at the next N cards of the deck for the cost of a gold card.

name: The Rat Sheet
mechanic: Raises a Rival Show's difficulty for everyone, but steals part of its fame if both parties pass.

name: The Regurgitator
mechanic: Swallows up to N cards and can produce them later in any chosen order.

name: The Renaming
mechanic: Sideshow class tags upgrade to a better-received class label after a vote event.

name: The Rider
mechanic: Long rule text hides one small instruction; obeying it doubles the card.

name: The Right to Perform
mechanic: A town tries to ban the show: comply for no fame, or resist to fight a hazard show for double fame and permanent town change.

name: The Ringmistress (Queen)
mechanic: Face-card rename to a troupe role.

name: The Rival Show (recurring boss)
mechanic: Goal score is pre-raised, but beating it steals one of the rival's cards.

name: The Rodeo Clown
mechanic: When a boss attacks a card, this card redirects the hit to itself.

name: The Rope Trick
mechanic: A card exists only in rumor pools and can never drop, until a hidden condition makes it real.

name: The Route Book
mechanic: Pre-run planning UI where the player traces an intended path; deviating from it costs fame.

name: The Séance Buster
mechanic: Reveals all Gaff/Humbug/fake cards on the board; +points per fake revealed.

name: The Scam Booking
mechanic: Arrive to find no venue; improvise a show where only commons score, or eat the failure; mirror version lets the player oversell (declare beyond deck) at risk.

name: The School (social circus)
mechanic: Converts discarded/junk cards into trained commons between runs.

name: The Scottish Play curse
mechanic: Cueing a cursed card by its true name triggers bad luck; a discoverable ritual sequence cleanses it.

name: The Screwjob
mechanic: Once per profile, a rule card betrays the player at the worst moment, legally by its own text.

name: The Seed
mechanic: A rank-1 card gains +1 rank every turn it stays covered.

name: The Sharpshooter (Oakley)
mechanic: Exact-rank effect: choose a rank each show; that rank scores double.

name: The show must go on (Pagliacci)
mechanic: +mult while this card carries a debuff.

name: The Showbag
mechanic: A cheap grab-bag pack of random commons with one guaranteed sweet item.

name: The Showdown
mechanic: Play the same town 'against' a rival's score; the winner takes both crowds.

name: The Shredder
mechanic: Destroys itself when sold and pays double its price.

name: The Singa Barong
mechanic: Carries an entire stack's weight; everything above it counts as one card for movement purposes.

name: The Sitter
mechanic: Rewards a card for remaining atop the same column across multiple shows.

name: The Skipping Tape
mechanic: A Gaff that already scored gets exposed retroactively; the player pays back its fame.

name: The Snowstorm
mechanic: A board-covering particle finale used as an endless-mode milestone.

name: The Soundcheck
mechanic: One free non-scoring rehearsal turn at show start: see the board, move once, no submit.

name: The Sphere (Final Venue)
mechanic: The town itself performs: board-wide visual effects modify play every turn.

source: DESIGN_REFERENCES.md §A8 Middle East, Central Asia, Mongolia
name: The Spin (whirling)
mechanic: A rotating card cycles its rank each turn (1 to King, then wraps to 1).

name: The Spirit Cabinet
mechanic: Cover this card fully and its column's effects trigger as if spotlit ('by spirits').

name: The Statue
mechanic: +points each turn it does not move; any movement resets the bonus.

name: The Steelpan
mechanic: Converts a junk/prop card into a scoring instrument card.

name: The stick game (Tahtib)
mechanic: A light sparring duel node.

name: The Stilt-walker
mechanic: Remains spotlit even when one card covers it.

name: The Stray Whistle
mechanic: A random Entrance card drops early into a random column.

name: The Streak
mechanic: Per-card win streaks are tracked on the card itself; fame scales with streak, and a broken streak fires a mourning event.

name: The String Figure
mechanic: Copy a displayed board-pattern with the player's cards for a bonus.

name: The Sweet Tooth (Morrison)
mechanic: All +rank buffs are permanent instead of lasting only one show.

name: The Synthetic Idol
mechanic: An Automaton whose skill is assembled from fragments of other cards' skills.

name: The System
mechanic: A card that 'predicted' whatever just happened (retroactive prophecy bonus); inspecting it reveals the trick and halves the bonus.

name: The Talking Wire
mechanic: Scores as both Acrobat and Clown class on the same trigger.

name: The Tarot Reading
mechanic: Cue: look at the top 5 cards of the deck and reorder them.

name: The Tent Challenge
mechanic: A town champion calls out one of the player's cards for a duel: win for gold, lose a rank.

name: The Three Rings
mechanic: Score three separate 5-card rings (rows) in one submit to permanently unlock a third zone rule card.

name: The Throw (ventriloquism)
mechanic: Cues a card's ability as if it were located in a different column.

name: The Tiger Queen (Stark)
mechanic: Consumption effects have no cap.

name: The Top
mechanic: Set spinning via cue; keeps scoring a little every turn until it topples after a random duration.

name: The Traceur
mechanic: Moves across the tops of columns, never entering stacks.

name: The Trance
mechanic: A card enters trance (acts autonomously, immune to everything) for N turns, then suffers a hard Exhaust.

name: The Triple
mechanic: If this card ends a run of exactly 3 cards assembled this turn, score it 3x.

name: The Turk
mechanic: An Automaton card secretly powered by the card hidden beneath it; its power equals the hidden card's rank, and removing that card stops it.

name: The Two Masks
mechanic: A flip-state card: comedy side buffs neighbors, tragedy side buffs itself; flips every time it scores.

name: The Uncredited Artist
mechanic: A hidden signature on the card art that, once found, adds the artist as a playable card.

name: The Unicorn
mechanic: An Animal Gaff that scores as legendary until any player effect inspects it.

name: The Unsanctioned Show
mechanic: Performing in a locked/forbidden node grants enormous fame; failing it loses the run's tips.

name: The Vine
mechanic: The first time this card would be destroyed by a fall/discard, it stops short and survives (once per tour).

name: The Wedding
mechanic: Permanently pair two cards so they always draw together.

name: The White Elephant War
mechanic: A rival offers a White Elephant card (huge points, drains gold); refusing makes the next Rival Show boss harder.

name: The Widow's Succession
mechanic: When a leader card is destroyed, its partner card inherits the leader slot and one signature power.

name: The Wing Walker
mechanic: Transfers a card between two moving columns during the Next-phase drop.

name: Three-box shuffle
mechanic: Rearrange any 3 adjacent cards' order on cue.

name: Thrown cards
mechanic: A Knives/card-throwing crossover card.

name: Ticket Stub
mechanic: Consumed as currency at shops for a discount; worthless if brought into the Ring.

name: Till Eulenspiegel deal
mechanic: A trickster's deal does exactly what its text says, not what was meant (monkey's-paw style reward).

name: Tour pre-planning
mechanic: Players open by planning their tour (choosing which cities to visit); beginners plan small tours, veterans plan longer routes.

name: Town size score requirements
mechanic: Small towns vs. big cities carry different score requirements.

name: Tragedy scoring (Circo criollo)
mechanic: Drama acts score on failed shows (tragedy sells).

name: Triangle map boss phase
mechanic: Every few rows features a boss phase, drawable as terrain, with fights possibly restricted to boss phases only.

name: Triangle map choice
mechanic: Player chooses from the next 3 card options; picking moves them up a tier while keeping the triangle shape; moving left permanently loses the right lanes (and vice versa), the middle loses both outer lanes.

name: Triangle map holes/packs
mechanic: The triangle can have holes; nodes should contain card packs rather than just single cards.

name: Trigger order
mechanic: Card effects trigger in order: field effects first, then the deck top-down, then the board left-to-right/top-to-bottom (including the input row), then the discard pile top-down.

name: Troupe adoption
mechanic: Any non-class card gains the current leader's class tag.

name: Turning the tip
mechanic: Converts an audience faction into fame; a blow-off is a hidden bonus objective revealed only after clearing a show.

name: Two-faction city (Parintins)
mechanic: Picking a faction on arrival changes the goal, the shop, and who heckles the player.

name: Two-zone board (Entrance/Ring)
mechanic: Board has an upper zone (Grand Entrance, where drawn cards wait) and a lower zone (The Ring, where the board is built).

name: TypeInput
mechanic: On turn start, passes its held child cards to the paired lower column, then takes a random card from the deck.

name: UI-manipulation win con
mechanic: Shelved idea: an alt win condition based on manipulating the scoring UI itself (duplicate-or-remove), with no good design found.

name: Undo at outcome screen
mechanic: Pressing Undo at the win/lose screen dismisses the outcome and rewinds the final Submit.

name: Uniqueness multiplier
mechanic: A separate early idea: a multiplier that grows with every unique effect triggered during a submit.

name: Universal deck resolves last
mechanic: The Universal (rule) deck is probably applied last in all modifier resolution order.

name: Universal placement ability
mechanic: A card ability lets any card be placed on top of it, overriding default stacking legality.

source: DESIGN_REFERENCES.md §A8 Middle East, Central Asia, Mongolia
name: Unpierceable
mechanic: Knife-suit projectiles pass through this card harmlessly (still counts as a 'miss' for stuntman bonuses).

name: Verse duel (repentistas)
mechanic: Alternate 'stanzas' (mini-submits) with a town champion; the first to fail a beat loses.

name: Viewable game laws
mechanic: Game laws are viewable as plain text via a greyed-out '?' button before the player has unlocked the rule deck itself, needed to explain prop-card abilities.

name: Visible-to-trigger + hidden-trigger stamp
mechanic: Abilities must be visible to trigger by default; a stamp lets a card trigger even while hidden/covered; deck triggers surface visually on the deck slot as they fire.

name: Voladores calendar meld
mechanic: A hidden ritual meld: 4 cards descending 13 ranks each (4x13=52) grants an end-of-run celestial bonus.

name: Voucher effects in main deck
mechanic: Voucher-type effects (player-side) go in the main deck instead of the rule deck.

name: Walking Through the Wall
mechanic: Move a card through an occupied slot to the other side.

name: Wall of Death
mechanic: Adjacent columns score +mult, but cards there take 1 Exhaust debuff per show.

name: Water Torture Cell escape chain
mechanic: A card locked under 3 conditions unlocks one per turn, paying out on the full escape.

name: Wax
mechanic: Rank slowly decreases each show it shares a column with a Flame-suit card.

name: Wax and Gold
mechanic: A card carries two rule texts: the visible 'wax' effect and a hidden 'gold' effect discovered by fulfilling the wax one.

name: Wheel of Death roulette
mechanic: A spinning bonus wheel whose payout lands where the last knife-suit card scored.

name: White Elephant
mechanic: Scores huge points, but each show it remains in the deck it eats 1 Gold card.

name: Whiteface/Auguste pairing
mechanic: A Whiteface card issues a cue that an adjacent Auguste card executes 'wrongly,' with a better result.

name: Whole-board submit
mechanic: Player continuously draws to build the board; pressing Submit evaluates and scores the entire board state, then clears it, with Entrance cards dropping down to seed the next board.

name: Wild pip
mechanic: A wild pip class tracks the previous pip inside itself, e.g. randomly choosing from pips present on the board/row/column, updating on every board change with cycling visuals.

name: Wildcard Pip (summary)
mechanic: Adopts the rank/suit of the card below it.

name: Winter Quarters
mechanic: Named meta-hub where prestige currency is spent between runs to prepare the next season.

name: X-Ray Eyes
mechanic: While this card is covered (blinded), the player can see all facedown/hidden cards.

name: Yu-Gi-Oh number scaling
mechanic: Base scoring values should be rebalanced upward so numbers are never single digits and always feel big.

name: Zip's Question Mark
mechanic: A card whose text is permanently just '?'.

name: Zone Adder (lower)
mechanic: Adds 1 Ring column per copy in the rule deck.

name: +1 reroll, no-repeat rerolls
mechanic: Add +1 reroll per game; for the rest of the game, repeated reroll actions do not give the same results.

name: 15 as rank via ability only
mechanic: Rank 15 is too hard to visually read and should only exist via an ability, not as a default rank.

name: 3 grids side by side, commit to one
mechanic: Each game fills 3 side-by-side 5x5 grids; card effects can influence other grids; player chooses which grid the next 5 entrance cards go into but must commit to a single grid once chosen.

name: 3 submits as 3 acts
mechanic: 3 submits per match could reference 3 performance acts.

name: 31/99-style fixed point values
mechanic: 31/99-style rank values: ace worth 1 or 11, 10 worth -10, King worth 99, others their rank; goal is reaching a target total.

name: 3D stacking as extra rows/cols
mechanic: Allow stacking cards on top of each other on the grid, adding a 3D element that functions as theoretical additional rows/columns.

name: 4-coordinate card position
mechanic: Every card's position is defined by 4 coordinates: which grid, x, y, and height.

name: 5 starting suits
mechanic: Starting with 5 suits instead of 4 is more balanced: makes flushes harder and allows an anti-flush hand.

name: 5-wide board for row hands
mechanic: A 5-column-wide board allows row-wide poker hands as well as column hands.

name: 500 Rummy free-meld-adding
mechanic: 500 Rummy: any player, regardless of turn order, can add to existing melds and take more than the top discard.

name: 500 Rummy turn-stealing
mechanic: 500 Rummy: a player can steal a turn if an opponent discards a card that could extend another meld.

name: 5D multiverse time-travel card
mechanic: Sends a card into the past to play out that board state until it clashes with the present, keeping only the differences.

name: 5x5 grid entrance placement redesign
mechanic: Core redesign: entrance shows top 5 cards as normal, but the player freely chooses where in a 5x5 grid below to place each one.

name: 5x5 grid replaces drop zones
mechanic: Replace the 5-6 drop-in zones with a 5x5 grid the player manually places entrance cards into.

name: Accordion pile-combining rule
mechanic: Accordion Solitaire: piles whose top cards match and are 3 apart (or adjacent) can be combined, newer cards going on top.

name: Accordion pile-matching rule
mechanic: Accordion Solitaire: draw a card, create a new pile if it doesn't match the newest pile's top card by suit or rank; can only stack on the newest pile.

name: Acrobatic tap-or-carryover charge
mechanic: Acrobatic card has 1 charge triggerable by tap; if unused, the charge carries to the next round.

name: Acrobatics leader archetype
mechanic: Acrobatics leader archetype: focuses on card movement.

name: Action-triggered negative events
mechanic: Events triggered by player actions, e.g. sacrificing too many talent cards causes a union strike, or having too many cards triggers a tax-evasion penalty losing basic cards.

name: Add all cards to map
mechanic: Add all cards to the map (as collectibles/nodes), not just special ones.

name: Adjacency-required marriage melds
mechanic: Add marriage-style melds that require cards to be exactly adjacent rather than merely in the same row/column.

name: Air material (top of deck)
mechanic: Air material type stays on top of the deck.

name: All In card
mechanic: On the next score, double the total score, then double the score needed for the next round.

name: Amogus fake card
mechanic: A card is secretly fake: when played it loses score and ignores the rules on certain turns; the player must find and remove it.

name: Animal trainer leader archetype
mechanic: Animal trainer leader archetype: focuses on stacking, including eating cards and cards auto-moving through the field.

name: Any card placeable on this card
mechanic: Card ability: any card can be placed on top of this card, modifying stacking rules.

name: Any-grid line-completion detector
mechanic: A card that detects a new 5-in-a-line completion anywhere across all grids and triggers its scoring.

name: Anything-stacks-here card
mechanic: Any card can be placed on top of this card.

name: Applause scales with score
mechanic: Applause/cheer feedback gets more impactful the higher an individual score is.

name: Ascension debuff cards
mechanic: Ascensions: each ascension level adds a chosen negative-effect card to the deck or rules deck, including permanent versions of boss environmental hazards.

name: Auction Pinochle bidder-only meld
mechanic: Auction Pinochle: only the auction winner picks trump and can score melds; other players act as defenders.

name: Audience patience meter
mechanic: Audience patience system: moving cards drops patience, triggering unique effects delays the drop, and cards auto-drop when patience hits 0.

name: Autochess-style ring type combo
mechanic: Autochess-inspired: multiple copies of a class/type of card within a single ring create special scaling effects, e.g. tying hoop/ball/fire/knife prop synergies to a same-type count in that ring.

name: Balanced prop targeting rules
mechanic: Alt balance: knives hit non-skill cards and hoops hit skill cards; balls buff skill cards and fire buffs non-skill cards, spreading buffs as evenly across the column as possible.

name: Balloon type
mechanic: Opposite of a heavy card: always rises to the top of the stack.

name: Balls
mechanic: Base suit: ball props (count = rank) arc down the column applying a Juggling status that pays out column score when that card later scores; stacking requires different suit and adjacent rank.

name: Base scoring: vertical runs + horizontal poker
mechanic: Base scoring is vertical runs (with a minimum size) plus horizontal poker hands.

name: Basic suit props sweep board
mechanic: Scored basic (non-skill) cards summon rank-scaled prop objects in their row/column that move across the board and interact with other cards.

name: Beehive four-of-a-kind removal
mechanic: Beehive Solitaire: allows removing a four-of-a-kind 'swarm' from the board.

name: Beggar My Neighbor forfeit rule
mechanic: Beggar My Neighbor: playing a face card forces the next player to pay a forfeit (4 cards for ace, 3 for K, 2 for Q, 1 for J).

name: Beggar My Neighbor number-card play
mechanic: Beggar My Neighbor: play continues normally on number cards (2-10).

name: Beggar My Neighbor pile-win rule
mechanic: Beggar My Neighbor: if all forfeit cards are non-face, the face-card player takes the whole middle pile; a face card among the forfeit passes the effect to the new face card.

name: Best Bower
mechanic: Wild suit that counts as every suit for melds/flushes and can stack anywhere; if untalented, randomly selects a prop from the entire game to trigger.

name: Bid-before-play mechanic proposal
mechanic: Proposed bid mechanic for this game: bet before play to gain extra points for hitting an exact number of melds.

name: Biome-based world/act map
mechanic: Game runs on a level/act/world system (One Step From Eden style) traveling through biomes that each affect map generation differently.

name: Blackjack bust rule
mechanic: Blackjack: score exactly 21 to win; going over 21 loses instantly.

name: Blackjack meld idea
mechanic: Blackjack-referencing scoring idea (unelaborated).

name: Blank rank
mechanic: Rank effectively 0; always passes stacking rank comparisons but cannot participate in rank-based melds or effects.

name: Board has deck/discard/ruleset zones
mechanic: The board has a deck zone, a discard deck zone, and a ruleset deck zone.

name: Booster reroll pool
mechanic: Booster reroll pool ships at 5 with a planned but unwritten reroll-count modifier content hook (a luck()-style effect).

name: Boss: adjacency-only placement
mechanic: Boss variant of entrance cards: only allows placing cards adjacent to each other when placing on the grid.

name: Boss debuffs as ruleset cards
mechanic: Negative boss-battle effects are temporary cards added to the ruleset deck, defined to self-destruct after the game/act.

name: Boss fire-breathing fight
mechanic: A boss appears that must be defeated with specific hands or raw point damage while it slowly breathes fire onto the player's actual score.

name: Boss phase every few rows
mechanic: Every few rows of the triangle map is a boss phase, visually designed to look like terrain.

name: Branching escalating-difficulty paths
mechanic: Branching map paths with escalating difficulty; split roguelike map campaigns from Klondike-like preset puzzle levels; battle levels use a preset board plus the player's own unlocked deck.

name: Bribery/memory-wipe extra life
mechanic: Bribery/Memory Wipe card: grants an extra life if a city/show is failed, letting the player keep going as if they had won.

name: Built-in symmetric PvP mode
mechanic: Built-in PvP mode: both players start with the same deck and aim for the highest score.

name: Burning cascades as combo source
mechanic: Open scoring knob: whether Burning-status cascades should count as a combo source.

name: Buttons and shops as cards
mechanic: All buttons should themselves be cards; e.g. a shop reroll is itself a tappable card on the board.

name: Calculation Solitaire base piles
mechanic: Calculation Solitaire: suits don't matter; start with ace/2/3/4 foundation piles, one waste pile each.

name: Calculation Solitaire looping stacks
mechanic: Calculation Solitaire: foundation piles stack in increments of their base number (1s, 2s, 3s, 4s), looping around past King.

name: Calculation Solitaire waste-pile rule
mechanic: Calculation Solitaire: cards that don't fit go on a waste pile; only the waste pile's top card can move to a foundation, and only if legal.

name: Canasta rank-based wildcards
mechanic: Canasta: certain ranks (e.g. 2s) act as wildcards.

name: Canfield 3-card stock draw
mechanic: Canfield Solitaire: stock is drawn 3 cards at a time, only the top of the 3 usable (then the next below it once used).

name: Canfield foundation build rule
mechanic: Canfield Solitaire: foundations build with same suit, ascending rank only.

name: Canfield foundation-rank feed
mechanic: Canfield Solitaire: a card matching the foundation base's rank, wherever found in reserve or stock, goes straight to the foundation.

name: Canfield tableau stacking rule
mechanic: Canfield Solitaire: tableau stacks 1 rank lower and opposite color; a whole stack can move if it follows this rule.

name: Card debuff statuses
mechanic: Debuff status effects on cards: e.g. Exhausted (loses rank at round end if it was on board), plus proposed Cancer and Parasites statuses.

name: Card groups boosted by leaders
mechanic: Cards belong to groups, and leader cards can boost the members of their group.

name: Card unlocks: action-based and score-based
mechanic: Dual unlock system: some cards unlock from specific in-game actions, others from reaching score/win thresholds; common cards from generic progress, rare cards from genre-specific play.

name: Cards as currency
mechanic: Instead of currency, cards themselves are the currency and are traded.

name: Cards auto-drop, no manual drag down
mechanic: Cards come down on their own and cannot be dragged down manually.

name: Cards bounce/swap between grids
mechanic: Card effects that can bounce cards to other grids or swap places between grids.

name: Cards have 1 parent/1 child stack
mechanic: Cards can have exactly 1 parent and 1 child card, forming a stack.

name: Carnival meta shop
mechanic: The overall meta shop is themed as a carnival.

name: Carrier-stacking bonus points
mechanic: Talents doing tricks on top of other 'carrier' talent cards earn extra points.

name: Champion card
mechanic: Cards of the same rank directly above or below this card are discarded.

name: Cheat bluff-discard rule
mechanic: Cheat: discard face-down while announcing (possibly falsely) what rank you're playing; next player can claim one rank higher, lower, or the same.

name: Cheat call-out resolution
mechanic: Cheat: calling 'cheat' makes the accused pick up the whole pile if lying, or the caller picks it up if the accused was truthful.

name: Cheat Day card
mechanic: Cheat Day: cards remaining in the deck get a rank increase.

name: Check scoring in deck/discard
mechanic: Scoring should also check cards sitting in the deck and discard pile, not just the board.

name: Checkers hop-capture card
mechanic: Checkers-inspired 'frog' card: allowed to hop over existing cards.

name: Cheering Team card
mechanic: Each scored card of the same suit as this card gets extra points.

name: Circular map / return-to-start
mechanic: Alt map shape ideas: circle the map instead of a final city, or require returning to the start after reaching a big enough city.

name: Circus suits, rank cap question
mechanic: Suits become clowns/dancers/flames/juggling balls/hoops/knives; aces are the actual performers; considering capping rank at 10.

name: Clown set bonus raises patience
mechanic: Each unique clown card on board raises patience by 1; collecting all of them gives a set bonus chance to not consume patience.

name: Clowns as wildcard/joker stand-ins
mechanic: Clowns can stand in for other cards, similar to a joker/wildcard, reflecting how circus clowns spoofed other acts.

name: Clowns leader archetype
mechanic: Clowns leader archetype: focuses on pip manipulation.

name: Collect number cards to progress
mechanic: Collect all number cards to progress to a stage where remaining boss face cards must be faced (Deadman Wonderland reference).

name: Column card
mechanic: Column-type card gives points to its column on score.

name: Column-locked entrance placement
mechanic: Restrict each column to accept only 1 entrance card, from any of the 5 entrance cards, rather than free column choice.

name: Combo card
mechanic: During scoring, cards gain temporary points equal to the hand they were scored in.

name: Combo increments per unique effect
mechanic: Row/column scoring becomes a combo system: score increments by 1 for each unique effect triggered, with heavier emphasis on card effects that do direct damage under specific conditions.

name: Commit-to-grid entrance rule
mechanic: Once the player places a card in a grid, all current entrance cards must be placed in that same grid before the entrance refreshes with 5 new cards.

name: Common-doubles-rare chain
mechanic: Common card: doubles the chance of rares appearing.

name: Compress-board button
mechanic: QOL: a compress-all-cards button converts the board into a flavorless sheet showing only pips and bright ability names (dimmed if inactive), maximizing readability.

name: Concessions leader archetype
mechanic: Concessions/food leader archetype: focuses on positive effects.

name: Connect 4 mini-mode
mechanic: Mini-game mode idea themed on Connect 4.

name: Constellation tour map, no backtrack
mechanic: FTL-style constellation map: cannot backtrack, touring cities to build fame, with environmental hazards and surprise weather.

name: Costume designer leader archetype
mechanic: Costume designer leader archetype: focuses on equipment/clothing/stamp slots.

name: Crazy Eights wild-suit rule
mechanic: Crazy Eights: eights are wild and choose the next suit; must stack matching suit or rank; drawing up to 3 cards if unable to play.

name: Crazy Tan escalating draw penalty
mechanic: Crazy Tan: unable-to-move players draw and skip, with the required draw increasing by 1 for each consecutive skip until someone moves.

name: Cribbage phase-1 scoring events
mechanic: Cribbage phase 1 scores for: total of exactly 15, pairing the opponent's last card, first card being a jack, or a sequence of 3+ consecutive cards (order-independent).

name: Cribbage phase-1 stack-to-31
mechanic: Cribbage phase 1: play cards building a running total up to 31 (ace=1, faces=10).

name: Cribbage phase-2 hand scoring
mechanic: Cribbage phase 2: score the played hand for 15-combinations, pairs, runs, 4/5-card flushes, and a jack.

name: Crit chance to increase score
mechanic: A chance to crit, increasing score.

name: Cross-game score carryover
mechanic: Scoring done outside the main game (side content) carries over into the next game.

name: Cross-grid row expansion setting
mechanic: A setting to make other grids expand their rows/zones too if one grid's rows expand due to increasing height.

name: Cross-path entrance bonus
mechanic: Card effect that rewards entrance cards crossing each other's paths on the way to their destination column.

name: Custom deck as final deck
mechanic: A player-built custom deck can serve as the final/endgame deck.

name: Dancer leader archetype
mechanic: Dancer/skill-tricks leader archetype: focuses on specific formations.

name: Decimal numbers (Half-Step hat)
mechanic: Rank evaluates as both itself and +1 simultaneously for all purposes (e.g. a 3 with this hat also counts as 2.5/2), letting one card double-count toward multiple melds like pairs and straights.

name: Deck auto-slotter
mechanic: While in the deck, if an open card with a legal slot is ever available, this card moves from the deck into that slot.

name: Deck click drop
mechanic: Each click of the deck causes new cards to drop down, rounds remaining decrease, and slots on the right score whatever card is put on them.

name: Deck unlocks combined with gimmick runs
mechanic: Deck unlocks (Balatro-style) combined with gimmick-run variants instead of a separate tab.

name: Deck variants change rules
mechanic: Different decks influence the starting deck and rules; decks can be combined and picked up during a run.

name: Decks as playable solitaire boards (vetoed)
mechanic: Considered (then vetoed) making every deck its own playable solitaire board so players could reorder or extract cards from it.

name: Deja Vu card
mechanic: This card remembers its board placement; the next time an open slot appears there, it moves there from anywhere.

name: Deterministic per-subsystem RNG streams
mechanic: Planned but unimplemented: deterministic per-subsystem RNG streams, required before any seed-sharing feature.

name: Devil's Grip +3 rank stacking
mechanic: Devil's Grip Solitaire: stacking requires strictly +3 rank, with the starting row determining the sequence.

name: Diamond type
mechanic: Doubles this card's score; costs +3 when traded in at shops.

name: Digital card cannot be discarded
mechanic: Digital card type: cannot be discarded from the board.

name: Disaster card packs
mechanic: Disaster-themed card packs appear as choices on the board.

name: Discard-to-deck on score
mechanic: On score, put 2 random cards from the discard pile back into the deck; an Exhaust variant skips the whole discard step.

name: Distancing card
mechanic: Card hovers at the top of the stack without blocking the card below it, and cannot be clicked (counts as an extra row).

name: Diversity-based scoring instead of combo
mechanic: Idea of scoring 'diversity' (variety of suits/types on board) as an alternative axis to the combo system.

name: Double trigger seal
mechanic: Seal: this card's effect triggers twice.

name: Draw-through then submit
mechanic: Constantly draw through the deck like classic solitaire, then submit to evaluate the entire board state and reset.

name: Dynamic input/board card count from rules
mechanic: The number of input cards and board cards is decided dynamically at game creation by iterating the rule deck (e.g. a rule dictating 5 input columns and 5 board columns).

name: Earth material (bottom of deck)
mechanic: Earth material type stays on the bottom of the deck.

name: Earthquake card
mechanic: Scrambles the board.

name: Effect art pops up on trigger
mechanic: When an effect plays, its art pops up on screen in the background as if it is being performed.

name: Effect trigger order
mechanic: Card effects trigger in order: field effects, then deck top-down (soon-to-be-drawn first, order hidden), then left-right top-down including entrance, then discard pile top-down (recent discards first).

name: Effect-trigger point gain
mechanic: Whenever a card triggers its effect, gain a point.

name: Egg card
mechanic: When submitted, this card instead becomes a completely random other card of higher rank.

name: Electricity
mechanic: On score (if untalented), scores points based on this card's rank plus the ranks of all orthogonally/diagonally connected electric-suit cards; stacking requires different suit and adjacent rank.

name: Elemental materials
mechanic: Elemental card materials: Earth, Air, Water, Fire.

name: Elemental movement types
mechanic: Elemental card types have custom movement, such as always staying on top or bottom of a stack.

name: Empty-zone rank buff (mancala effect)
mechanic: Manipulate what an empty zone does to the next card placed on it, e.g. a mancala-style effect where a zone temporarily raises the rank of whatever is placed there (shown as +X).

name: Encounters as mini solitaire games
mechanic: Map encounters could be mini solitaire games in their own right.

name: End show early with good entrance
mechanic: Entrance cards are global by default; during the final performance, the player can choose to end early if the current entrance cards are good.

name: Entrance cards act via ability
mechanic: Entrance/input cards get their draw-and-pass functionality implemented as an ability: on turn start, pass child cards to the board card in the same column, then draw a random card from the deck.

name: Entrance drop-down between acts
mechanic: Planned but unimplemented: an entrance drop-down step between acts.

name: Entrance-set betting proposal
mechanic: Proposed betting system comparing the value of the current entrance set versus the next entrance set.

name: Entrance zone cards seed first column
mechanic: 5 entrance/input zone cards work as today, refreshing in random draw order once empty or the current grid is full; the 1st input card corresponds to the 1st column of the 5x5 grid.

name: Eruption card
mechanic: Cards receive a burned effect that spreads in an expanding snake pattern, with no counter available.

name: Escape artist leader archetype
mechanic: Escape artist/stuntsman leader archetype: focuses on negative effects.

name: Every 5th row red
mechanic: Every 5 rows, make that row red (visual scoring marker/threshold).

name: Exchange Voucher card
mechanic: Exchange Voucher: a special deck card usable to swap itself with any card currently on screen.

name: Eye of God card
mechanic: Eye of God: allows seeing all decks and true (unobscured) card descriptions.

name: Eye stamp shows mini skill art
mechanic: Eye stamp allows a card to stay active despite being covered, showing a miniature version of the skill art inside the stamp.

name: Face cards worth 10
mechanic: Face cards all count as 10 when adding to a hand total.

name: Fame gate every 10 levels
